nom: Origins Checks and Balances Daily Exfoliating Toner

avis.texte: I've been using this Origins toner for about a week and I'm really impressed with how my skin has been looking and feeling. My skin feels smoother and more refreshed, and I've noticed that it doesn't get as oily throughout the day. My pores also appear more refined, and even some of the small whiteheads and congestion I had seemed to improve pretty quickly. I like that the formula contains AHA, BHA, and Witch Hazel to gently exfoliate and help remove excess oil, dead skin, and impurities that may be left behind after cleansing. It leaves my skin feeling very clean and clarified without feeling overly harsh. I also really enjoy the fresh scent. With continued use, my skin looks clearer, smoother, and more balanced. I would definitely consider purchasing the full size bottle once I finish this one I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes

I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes. I found this product to be helpful in helping to clear my acne, prone skin, but a little too aggressive for my sensitive skin. I used it max 3x a week and found it worked the best there. Overall I would recommend to people who have tougher skin than i do.

I received this product for free from origins for testing and review purposes. I used this toner everyday for a week morning and night. I struggle with acne and I will say that I have seen a difference in my skin clearing up. The toner has a nice earthy scent to it which is very appealing. I will be buying this in the largest size they offer!

avis.titre: I would buy it again and again
avis.texte: This is my first time using an origin product, and I am pleasantly surprised. This left my skin feeling smooth hydrated and glowing. I recommend this as a light tone to use before applying moisturizer and makeup. I received this product for free from origins for testing and review purposes.

This product is awesome for after cleansing the face. It feels so refreshing and clean and a great add on to my routine when I do an everything shower. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

This product is so so so good! I have been using it for about a week, and I have noticed my skin looks smoother, less pimply, less oily, and more pore-refined. Even after the first use, my whiteheads on the side of my face went down; it was amazing!! I love the smell and trust this product totally on my sensitive skin. Once my little sample size runs out, I am definitely buying the full bottle; I love it that much! I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Smells nice, but I was hoping for more
avis.texte: I didn't notice much of an immediate difference in my pores after using this toner, but it was super easy to incorporate into my routine. It has a nice scent and is quick and convenient to use, even if I didn't see the results I was hoping for. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes. I have been using this toner for several days and have already noticed a difference in the size of my pores and the smoothness of my skin. It is gentle enough to be used daily, but high effective.

I like this toner! The smell is very natural and doesn't irritate my skin. I noticed that it removed some extra foundation that I was wearing that day so that is a plus for getting my skin extra clean. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

(Orange is before, pink is after) I've been using this for a week now and it is pretty good! I noticed that after using my skin feels very soft and smooth, it also helps my other skincare products absorb much quicker. I love using toners to cleanse my skin deeper than a cleanser can and this does exactly that. I find that the witch hazel helps reduce sweating a little bit. The only downside is the smell is a little strong which can be bad for some people, i don't have much of a problem with it though just keep that in mind! I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I really enjoyed this toner. It smells nice and earthy, a natural fragrance that doesn't feel like it will aggravate my skin. I used it after removing my makeup and cleansing and found that it took off additional makeup and buildup that would have otherwise been left behind. I really liked this product. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Refreshing Addition to My Skincare Routine
avis.texte: I've been using the Origins Checks & Balances Daily Toner mostly at night as part of my skincare routine, and I've really enjoyed adding it to the steps I already have in place. The toner has a lightweight, refreshing texture that feels comfortable on my skin and doesn't leave it feeling heavy or sticky afterward. It applies easily and absorbs fairly quickly, which makes it convenient to use when I'm getting ready for bed. One of the things I noticed right away was the scent. It has a fresh, clean fragrance that makes the experience feel refreshing without being overwhelming. I also like the overall feel of the toner on my skin—it gives me that clean, refreshed feeling after cleansing and helps make my skincare routine feel a little more complete. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Fresh, Balanced Skin in One Step
avis.texte: I received the Origins Checks and Balances Daily Exfoliating Toner for free to test, and I'm genuinely surprised by how much I've enjoyed it. The formula is super lightweight, absorbs instantly, and leaves my skin feeling clean without any tightness. After using it consistently, my T‑zone looks more balanced and my skin feels smoother overall. What I appreciate most is how gentle it is — it exfoliates without irritation, and it fits easily into my routine. It's one of those products you don't expect to love, but it ends up becoming something you reach for every day. Definitely a great addition to my skincare lineup.

I've been using this toner in the morning after washing my face, and I've really liked it so far. It feels super light and refreshing, and my skin feels clean without feeling dry or tight afterward. The texture is nice and absorbs quickly, and I like that it leaves my skin feeling balanced before the rest of my skincare. Overall, it's been an easy product to work into my routine, and my skin has been feeling really smooth. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I really enjoyed using this daily toner. It feels refreshing on the skin and leaves my face clean, balanced, and hydrated without any sticky residue. After using it consistently, my skin looked smoother and felt softer. It layers well with the rest of my skincare routine and didn't cause any irritation. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly and gives my skin a healthy, fresh appearance. I would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a gentle everyday toner.

Smells very pepperminty, didn't irritate my skin. Felt nice, i used a cotton pad to apply it. Did leave my skin feeling a little dry but thats all. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: Smells just like checks and balances cleanser
avis.texte: I love the smell just like the checks and balances cleanser and feels good on skin! I. Love that minty smell!

I absolutely loved this toner. Everything about it was great! The smell, how It left my skin feeling just right & with this cool & clean feeling. Loved it!!!

I was surprised by how much I really liked this! I am always worried about toners stripping my skin but this felt great. It didn't dry it out and it felt really refreshing and light after. – Everything worked perfectly. I would use it again and recommend it without hesitation.

It made my oily skin feel balanced and clean! Would definitely purchase again!
This is a wonderful toner made my skin look and feel great made me feel great about myself and have a good attitude for the day because my skin just looks so wonderful Will recommend this product

I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes and liked how light the toner felt on my skin. It absorbed quickly and moisturized my face well which was ideal since I used it before serum. I would use this while traveling as well!

avis.titre: This toner is by far my preferred choice.
avis.texte: I have incorporated the Checks and Balances Daily Exfoliating Toner from Origins into my evening skincare regimen, following cleansing with the Origins Checks and Balances foam wash. I am highly satisfied with the product's performance. Its refreshing, lightweight texture absorbs rapidly, leaving no sticky residue. Within a few days of consistent use, I observed a noticeable improvement in skin smoothness and a more balanced complexion, particularly in the T-zone where oiliness is typically a concern. The clean, subtly minty fragrance is also a pleasant attribute, contributing to a more relaxing and refreshing skincare experience. My skin feels thoroughly clean and the mild fragrance promotes a sense of calm before sleep. Furthermore, I experienced no irritation despite having sensitive skin. This product was provided to me by Origins for testing and review purposes.
A wonderful toner that leaves you feeling clean and fresh! Pleasant mint aroma! "I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes."

This product has quickly become a staple in my nighttime routine. It is lightweight and not at all sticky on the skin. After applying, I notice a glow to my skin that remains into the following morning. The light scent is relaxing and pairs well with my moisturizer. I received this product for free from Origins for testing and review purposes.

I've been using the CHECKS AND BALANCES™ Daily Exfoliating Toner from Origins both in the morning and at night after cleansing, and I honestly loved how it made my skin feel. It has a refreshing, lightweight texture that absorbs quickly without leaving any stickiness behind. After just a few days, my skin felt smoother and looked more balanced, especially around my T-zone where I usually get oily. I also really enjoyed the clean, slightly herbal scent—it feels spa-like and calming, which makes my skincare routine feel more relaxing. In the morning it helped my skin feel fresh and prepped for makeup, and at night it made my skin feel clean but not stripped. Overall, it gave me a nice gentle exfoliation that didn't irritate my skin.

It had a light herbal scent that faded pretty quickly, which I loved, kinda like using a potion to fight off excess oil. I used it both morning and night, and it felt super refreshing without any sticky feeling. Definitely felt my skin a lot smoother. For someone with a combo skin type this toner is a must, it helped keep the oil on my nose in check. I should also add I received this product for free from origins for testing and review purposes.

avis.titre: A New Staple in My Night Routine
avis.texte: I've been using this Origins product consistently as part of my nighttime routine, and I'm really impressed so far. The texture is smooth and lightweight, making it easy to apply without feeling heavy or greasy on my skin. It absorbs quickly and leaves my face feeling soft and refreshed by the morning. I especially enjoyed the subtle, clean scent it's not overpowering.. After a few uses, I noticed my skin looked more hydrated and had a healthier glow. It also didn't irritate my skin, which is a big plus for me, being as though I have very sensitive skin

This toner feels lightweight and refreshing, perfect for dry combination and sensitive skin. It gently balances oil without stripping moisture, leaving skin calm and soft. Slight herbal scent, but non-irritating. Great for daily use when you want subtle hydration and a clean, balanced finish.
